name: Матовий майстер: мат на g7
description:
Mate monsters love delivering checkmates. In this lesson, you will use some nice chess tricks to target the mate square g7.

The monster skills that you will use are a pin and removing the guard. You already know these tricks from previous lessons. This time, you will apply them to set up mate.

Study the examples to see how this works.

What do you have to do?

Deliver checkmate on g7 (red square). Use your mate monster skills (pin or removing the guard).

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rg7]} 1. Qg4+ Ng6 {[%csl Gg6][%cal Gc4g8,Rf7g6]} 2. Qxg6+ Kh8 3. Qg7# 1-0
examples.text:
The red square g7 is the target. White advances quickly and checks the king.

If the black king steps aside, White’s queen can checkmate it on g7.

So, Black thinks of something else.

He moves his knight between his king and the white queen.

Blacks appears to have saved himself from mate.

But look at the black knight. Is it really safe?

The knight is guarded by the pawn, but the pawn cannot leave its spot.
It is pinned by the white bishop!

And you know that pinned pieces are lousy defenders.

White can simply take the knight with his queen!
In the next move, White’s queen moves to g7 and mates the king.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rg7]} 1. Qg4+ Kh8 {[%cal Ge6g7,Rg4g7]} 2. Bxe6 Qxe6 3. Qg7# 1-0
examples.text:
Again, White starts off by having his queen check the king.
The king steps aside.
But White cannot go for checkmate on g7, yet, as the black knight is protecting this square.

No problem: it is easy to defeat the defender!

Do you see how White can do that?

The white bishop takes the black knight.
If Black recaptures, White’s queen moves to g7: checkmate!
